name: DICE
structured: JSON-LD MusicEvent + __NEXT_DATA__ (status, age, lineup with set times, refund policy, door sales, price from, multi-day)
strengths: Main ticket source; full structured data per event page
cautions: robots.txt: only /api/ disallowed. Structured performer list can show 1 artist while the description names 20: never build a lineup from one field. A cheapest-ticket price is not an all-weekend pass.
notes: party_dice_request() / party_dice_ingest() refresh every event page

name: House of Yes
strengths: The model for a rich party page: concept, dress, performances, age, policies; FAQ at houseofyes.org/faq
cautions: Official site can say "full lineup TBA" while Shotgun lists more names: do not present the longer list as final. Official no-refund policy differs from DICE: show refund terms per ticket seller.

name: Gray Area
strengths: Long write-ups, artist bios and photos, lineups, location pages (/events/<slug>/location)
cautions: Artist photos are not ours to reuse.

name: Resident Advisor
strengths: Best for electronic and underground: promoter, lineup, long description, price, age, policies, accessibility
cautions: HTTP 403 to automated requests (checked 13.10.2026). Manual research only; never scrape.

name: Shotgun
strengths: Concept and music descriptions, organizer, hours, address
cautions: HTTP 429 (rate limited) on 13.10.2026; city lists returned stale snapshots. Manual cross-check only.

name: BASEMENT
strengths: Artist texts and separate lineups per room (Main Room / Studio)
cautions: Needs a browser to read; 120bpm carries its listings.

name: Elsewhere
strengths: Official calendar: artists, door times, age, practical details. Important for verification
cautions: Mixes concerts with club nights: filter.

name: Hot Rabbit
strengths: LGBTQ parties with rich descriptions, performers, flyers, dress and rules
cautions: Also lists past events: filter by date.

name: MTS Productions
strengths: Latin and reggaeton: concept, dress, VIP
cautions: Promoter's own copy, not an independent review.

name: SOB's
strengths: Beyond electronic: concept, genres, hours, price, age
cautions: The sample page was a past event.

name: Partiful
strengths: Community parties with good descriptions
cautions: robots.txt disallows AI crawlers (ClaudeBot, GPTBot): never fetch automatically. Some addresses only after RSVP: such a party is not published with an address.

name: Posh
strengths: Event discovery
cautions: HTTP 403 on 13.10.2026; only basic details verified in the research.

name: Teksupport (via DICE)
strengths: Follow one major promoter's events through DICE

name: Joonbug
strengths: Halloween and New Year's Eve pages with concept, open bar, age, photos, VIP and ticket terms
cautions: robots.txt asks for Crawl-delay 10 seconds. Lists venues outside NYC: keep the five boroughs only.

name: Fever
strengths: Seasonal events
cautions: The checked Halloween page had content but no tickets on sale: never show availability without checking.

name: 120bpm
strengths: Electronic/club calendar with times, venues, sometimes price and age
cautions: Cross-check only, never the only source.

name: doNYC
strengths: Parties next to shows and activities
cautions: Filter what is really a party.

name: Eventbrite
strengths: Another discovery channel
cautions: The checked link is one category in Brooklyn, not all of NYC.

name: Discotech
strengths: Club calendars, artists, photos, venue details
cautions: Secondary cross-check source.

name: The Best Parties
strengths: Weekend round-ups for discovery and editorial choice
cautions: Verify prices with the promoter.

name: Knockdown Center
strengths: Official calendar
cautions: Event content not verified in the research (dynamic page).

name: 19hz
strengths: List of sources and promoters to widen research
cautions: No NYC-specific calendar verified.
